title: Speak or Stay Silent: Context-Aware Turn-Taking in Multi-Party Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2603.11409v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing voice AI assistants treat every detected pause as an invitation to speak. This works in dyadic dialogue, but in multi-party settings, where an AI assistant participates alongside multiple speakers, pauses are abundant and ambiguous. An assistant that speaks on every pause becomes disruptive rather than useful. In this work, we formulate context-aware turn-taking: at every detected pause, given the full conversation context, our method decides whether the assistant should speak or stay silent. We introduce a benchmark of over 120K labeled conversations spanning three multi-party corpora. Evaluating eight recent large language models, we find that they consistently fail at context-aware turn-taking under zero-shot prompting. We then propose a supervised fine-tuning approach with reasoning traces, improving balanced accuracy by up to 23 percentage points. translated_title: 发言还是保持沉默：多方对话中的上下文感知话轮转换
translated_abstract: 现有的语音AI助手将每个检测到的停顿都视为发言的邀请。这种方式在双人对话中行之有效，但在多方对话场景中——即AI助手与多个说话者共同参与对话时——停顿大量存在且含义模糊。一个在每个停顿处都发言的助手会变得具有干扰性而非有用性。在这项工作中，我们提出了上下文感知话轮转换的概念：在每次检测到停顿时，基于完整的对话上下文，我们的方法来决定助手应该发言还是保持沉默。我们构建了一个包含超过12万条标注对话的基准数据集，涵盖三个多方对话语料库。通过对八个近期大语言模型的评估，我们发现它们在零样本提示下始终无法完成上下文感知话轮转换任务。随后，我们提出了一种带有推理轨迹的监督微调方法，将平衡准确率提升了最多23个百分点。我们的研究结果表明，上下文感知话轮转换并非一种涌现能力（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“上下文感知话轮转换”新任务——在多方对话的停顿处判断AI助手应发言还是沉默，发现八个现有大语言模型零样本下均无法胜任，并借助带推理轨迹的监督微调将平衡准确率提升最多23个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces context-aware turn-taking—deciding whether an AI assistant should speak or stay silent at pauses in multi-party dialogue—showing that eight recent LLMs consistently fail at this zero-shot, while supervised fine-tuning with reasoning traces improves balanced accuracy by up to 23 percentage points.
